# cf-rollback: prepare and record a rollback

Use this skill when a post-deploy check fails and the deployed release
must go back to the previous one. The agent prepares the rollback; the
operator runs it in production.

1. Find the previous release tag in the release ledger.
2. Verify the artifact hash of that tag against the ledger entry.
3. Run `deploy --to <tag>` in staging and confirm the failing check passes
   there.
4. Hand the production command to the operator. Never run it yourself:
   the operator says go.
5. Record the rollback in the release ledger with the reason and the
   failing check.

Do not roll back a database migration with this skill; use `cf-migrate`.
